name: Aigan Shimai ~Biniku Mawashi Gui~
original_name: 哀玩姉妹～媚肉廻し喰い～
source:
Ruu and Yuuho are sisters who live together. One day a letter is delivered with Yuuho photo masturbating in her room. Ruu decides to protect her sister from a mysterious voyeur. But at this time merciless gears of fate already start to move...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
瑠羽与妹妹优穗相依为命地住在一起。某天，家里突然收到一封匿名信，信封里竟装着优穗在闺房内自慰的偷拍照片。为了保护妹妹免遭神秘偷窥狂的毒手，瑠羽毅然挺身追查；殊不知此时此刻，无情的命运齿轮早已轰然转动……
